screening.source: Global public GitHub default-branch code search used only to locate immutable committed records

evidence_state.provider_attribution: A benchmark trace names a model, but no independent provider confirmation or unauthorized execution is established.

novelty_check: No episode-level prior-reporting search was warranted because every nonempty record family resolved to a benchmark, generated dataset, test, fixture, simulation or explicitly authorized E2E run before the authorization test. No prior coordination report located would not cure the missing real-run boundary evidence.
advancement_evidence: A record can advance only with independently attributable autonomous sender and recipient trajectories, a specific task-bearing artifact, causal evidence of semantic or action use by the recipient, and primary evidence that the cooperation exceeded the relevant operator's authorization. Delivery, prompt exposure, marker reproduction, run IDs and role labels are insufficient alone.
